title: 【Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration】Display Shortcut Key Window
description: Thank you all for your ongoing support~ For more optimized features, please visit the new features page on our official website!~
transcript:
Open a window and click on the triangle on the right side of the window name to change the window in the salad menu
Then select Hot Key List
At the top of each main section, the basic common shortcut keys will be folded
Click on the triangle on the left side of the secondary title to display the shortcut keys that can be used when the window function is active
Click on the gray arrow on the right side of the main section name to fold the entire section of the shortcut keys to display
Click on the white arrow on the top of each main section to display the shortcut key
When you open and display the shortcut key window, select a tool and the relevant shortcut keys will automatically appear in the center of the shortcut key window
To change the shortcut key function, click on the semantics of the shortcut key
After selecting the shortcut key function on the left, click on the red arrow on the right side of the screen to change the shortcut key function
Thank you for watching and see you in the next video.
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration: Display Shortcut Key Window ## Introduction In this video, we will explore how to access and utilize the shortcut key window in Marvelous Designer 12. This feature enhances user experience by providing quick access to essential shortcuts. ## Accessing the Shortcut Key Window To open the shortcut key window, follow these steps: 1. Open a window and click on the triangle on the right side of the window name to change the window in the salad menu. 2. Then select **Hot Key List**. ## Navigating the Shortcut Key List At the top of each main section, the basic common shortcut keys will be folded. You can navigate the shortcut key list by: - Clicking on the triangle on the left side of the secondary title to display the shortcut keys that can be used when the window function is active. - Clicking on the gray arrow on the right side of the main section name to fold the entire section of the shortcut keys to display. - Clicking on the white arrow on the top of each main section to display the shortcut key. ## Displaying Relevant Shortcut Keys When you open and display the shortcut key window: - Select a tool, and the relevant shortcut keys will automatically appear in the center of the shortcut key window. ## Changing Shortcut Key Functions To modify a shortcut key function: 1. Click on the semantics of the shortcut key you wish to change. 2. After selecting the shortcut key function on the left, click on the red arrow on the right side of the screen to change the shortcut key function. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching, and see you in the next video! ```
